semantic.justification: Direct TypeScript port of the pinned md4c 0.5.3 UTF-8 block, mark-resolution and callback pipeline. Preserves source byte offsets, callback chunk boundaries and attributes, source flag defaults, reference budgets, container state and callback abort codes. All 813 complete callback streams match compiled unmodified md_parse, including 733 bundled CommonMark/extension cases. Native allocation failures, C pointer ABI and unused/uninitialized fields are not emulated. Writer callback integration remains pending; these dependency fixtures do not establish complete Writer import parity. B8TCAE producer audit:  Six further independently compiled public-parser cases preserve all82 earlier native outputs and include repeated stale candidate lengths, multi-line search and leading blanks. Actual source cache reuse reaches the formerly missing update alternative; this owner reaches strict100% with no exception or parser-state replacement. The complete8-suite/2017-test parser run passes all assertions; six-owner statements/lines/functions are100%, while two unresolved alternatives keep the combined branch gate failing. Runtime algorithms, original C source, input discovery and100% thresholds remain unchanged; full callback-detail/Writer model/ABI equivalence is not claimed.
